name: SendGrid
description: Twilio SendGrid email delivery platform: v3 REST API for transactional sending, templates, marketing contacts, stats and suppression management.
access_notes: Signup and API-key creation are fully self-serve (Settings > API Keys, scoped permissions, used as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'). However, SendGrid retired its legacy free plans in May 2025; new accounts get a 60-day timed free trial (100 emails/day), after which a paid plan is required to keep sending. No OAuth for API access; Basic auth is supported for some services with username 'apikey'.
mcp_notes: Composio SENDGRID toolkit exists (364 tools, API key auth). No official SendGrid vendor MCP: Twilio's official alpha MCP (@twilio-alpha/mcp) covers Twilio's Public API, not the SendGrid v3 email API; a Twilio blog post about a SendGrid MCP is a community build-it-yourself tutorial.
uncertainty_notes: None significant. An earlier draft cited the Event Webhook page via a Twilio docs mirror host (live.docs.dev.twilio.com), since replaced with the canonical www.twilio.com URL, which was re-verified live and confirms the webhook claim.

evidence.note: v3 REST API authenticates with scoped API keys via 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' header; keys created in the SendGrid console
Official changelog: Free Email API and Free Marketing Campaigns plans retired starting May 27, 2025; paid plan required after 60-day transition
New accounts from March 25, 2025 get a 60-day timed free trial (100 emails/day); sending stops after trial unless upgraded to a paid plan
Official Event Webhook docs: SendGrid POSTs email event data (delivery/engagement) to your URL, with Signature Verification and/or OAuth 2.0 verification
Composio toolkit catalog lists SENDGRID: 364 tools, API_KEY auth
